proposed_comments.title: Keep the plugin entry aligned with the table columns
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the plugin entry aligned with the table columns

**Severity:** `low`

The extra leading pipe creates an empty first cell, so this row has four columns while the header and neighboring rows have three. Markdown renderers can shift the plugin and author cells into the wrong columns or omit the description; remove the redundant pipe so the entry renders consistently.

```suggestion
| [WebSearchShortcut](https://github.com/Daydreamer-riri/CmdPal-WebSearchShortcut) | [Daydreamer-riri](https://github.com/Daydreamer-riri) | Web Search Shortcut Plugin for PowerToys Run |
```

confidence.rationale: The pinned upstream diff directly adds the extra leading pipe; the table header and neighboring rows establish the three-column format, and the literal replacement removes only the unintended empty cell.
